position: First element of the HTTP response status line (e.g., HTTP/1.1 200 OK)
explanation: HTTP status code returned for the DAAP request; it indicates whether the HTTP-level request succeeded or failed and distinguishes response types before the DAAP body is considered.

position: Root DAAP response body container field, tagged with content code 'mstt'
explanation: DAAP/DMAP response status code present in every DAAP response body; clients use it to determine whether the DAAP request succeeded or failed, independently of the HTTP status.
